output.reason: [ev-707b74e58c3e] describes one concrete change. The ingester HTTP handler `/ingester/flush_shutdown`, already deprecated, is removed in 3.0.0 and replaced by `/ingester/shutdown?flush=true`. That is enough to write the open applicability aspect: exposed environments are those whose automation calls the removed endpoint. This is a runtime-usage condition that more release text would not make clearer. The excerpt does not say what happens to callers or name any configuration that reveals use of the endpoint, so the condition is inferred from the removal rather than stated, which is why confidence is low.
